run_memory_write_cli: run the memory_write CLI tool to save content with embeddings and tags to a JSON memory file
create_ngrams_from_tokens: create n-grams from a sequence of tokens using the generate_ngrams function with a specified n value
extract_keywords_via_embeddings: extract top keywords from text by computing cosine similarity between content and n-gram embeddings
save_content_to_persistent_memory: save text content with its embedding and auto-extracted tags to a persistent JSON memory file
review_memory_write_function: review the memory_write function that tokenizes text, extracts tags, and appends to a JSON memory store
